01 — What I need you to know

I don’t know how to say this without it hurting.
So I’ll just say it.

Hey Saloni,

It’s your birthday. I should have been the reason you smiled today, and instead I’m the reason you’re hurting. That is the heaviest sentence I have ever had to write.

I’m sorry. I’m so, so sorry.

Not the quick kind of sorry that wants to be forgiven fast. The kind that sits up at night and replays everything. I replay the things I said. I replay your face when they landed. I can still hear your silence, and it is louder than any argument we ever had.

You were never too much. You were never the problem. You trusted me with the softest, most honest part of you, and I was careless with it. You asked for so little: to be heard, to feel safe, to feel chosen. And I made you feel the opposite. I will carry that shame for a long time, and I think I should.

I remember all of us. The kids in those old photos who didn’t know anything about life but somehow already knew about each other. The Feb 14. The rooftop. The puppy in your arms and your whole face lighting up. Almost every good memory I own has you standing in it.

Now my days are quiet in the wrong way. I pick up my phone a hundred times to tell you something small, a joke, a song, a thought, and then I remember I’ve lost the right to. Nobody warns you how much silence can weigh.

I’m not here to defend myself. No “but.” No “you also.” Only this: I was wrong, you were hurt, and it is on me.

Please, and I’m not demanding, I’m asking with everything I have: if there is even a small corner of your heart that still remembers who I was to you, let me earn my way back. Not today. Not on my schedule. On yours.

And if you can’t, if you need to walk away, I won’t chase you or make you feel guilty. I’ll understand. I will still be grateful for every day you gave me, and I will still wish you every happiness in the world.

Happy birthday, Saloni. You deserved to be celebrated today, not hurt. I’m sorry I couldn’t give you that.

Forever sorry, and still yours,

From my heart ♥
02 — Our little world

Some moments I hold close.

A few memories, a thousand feelings. They remind me how precious you are to me.

Part two — no walls, no pride

Look at how far
we came.

From kids who didn’t know anything, to two people who somehow knew everything about each other. Somewhere in between, I forgot how lucky I was.

Back then
Along the way
Our little family
SWIPE →

You didn’t fall for a perfect person. You fell for a flawed one, and you stayed through his worst days. I repaid that badly, and I will never stop being sorry.

If you’re reading this and your eyes are wet, so are mine. Not to make you feel guilty. Just because it’s true: you matter this much.

03 — If I could go back

What I would
do differently.

  • 01I would listen before I spoke, and hear what you were really telling me.
  • 02I would choose you over my ego, every single time.
  • 03I would hold you instead of arguing.
  • 04I would say “I’m sorry” the first time, not after I almost lost you.
  • 05I would make your birthday the happiest day of your year.

I can’t go back. But I can change from here, and I will, with or without a second chance.

04 — Happy birthday, Saloni

I’m not asking you to heal overnight.

Take all the time you need. Whatever you decide, I’ll carry this sorry with me and I’ll carry you in my heart. I’ll be here when you’re ready, and I’ll do my best to become someone who brings peace to your heart, not pain.

I’m sorry, Saloni. Truly.

Happy birthday, Saloni ♥
